snippet.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Henry on his adventure in the most anticipated RPG of this year! Kingdom Come: Deliverance will be available worldwide on February 13th 2018! 

Get your copy today: http://kcd.kochmedia.com
